title: Ukrainian Lamb Kidney Dumplings
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish featuring lamb kidney and dumplings, low in fat and full of flavor, bringing back nostalgic memories of home cooking
instructions: Combine flour, eggs, water, salt, and pepper in a large bowl to make the dumpling dough
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic
Divide the dough into small pieces and roll each piece into a ball
Flatten each ball into a thin circle
Place a few pieces of lamb kidney in the center of each circle
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the dumpling
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the dumplings for 10 minutes
While the dumplings are cooking, heat the malt extract in a pan over medium heat
Add the chopped onion to the pan and cook until it is caramelized
Serve the dumplings with the malt extract and onion sauce
